title: Hugo Site Maintenance for Research Websites
description: A ScholarSkills package (SS-0012) for maintaining a Hugo site on GitHub Pages: inspect before creating, compare the published site with the clone, audit front matter, alt text and broken internal links, and read the deploy run instead of rewriting the build.
